title: Design a controlled harness improvement trial
objective: Prepare a reversible champion-versus-challenger evaluation of one bounded orchestration change without modifying research goals, permissions, or evaluation standards.
deliverables: A frozen evaluation manifest with separate development and held-out task IDs
A preregistered scorecard, paired comparison, resource cap, and rollback condition
An independent review of leakage risks and opportunities to game the score
A ledger entry marked proposed or rejected; no fabricated execution or promotion
success_criteria: Only one interpretable harness change is proposed
Evaluation tasks and scorer versions are fixed before any held-out execution
Correctness and evidence gates cannot be traded away for lower cost
The proposal records unknown measurements and has an explicit rollback path
stop_conditions: The assignment or round budget is exhausted
The candidate requires expanded goals, permissions, or spending authority
Held-out material is exposed during candidate development
An independent evaluation cannot be arranged; retain the proposal without claiming a gain
